problem.title: Number of Visible People in a Queue
problem.problemStatement: There are n people standing in a queue, each having a distinct height. For every person, determine how many people to their right are visible. A person j is visible to person i if: j > i Every person between i and j has a height smaller than both person i and person j. Return an array where the i-th element is the number of people visible to the right of person i.
problem.constraints: 1 <= n <= 10^5 1 <= heights[i] <= 10^5 All heights are distinct.
